title: C211 blocked: Blender normal fidelity needs an explicit contract decision
body:
## Scope and ownership
Owner: c211-blender-7of9-20261111. Base observed main: 4f7a62cf965066ee7f27540c3c5f2554732c6950. Work branch: work/c211-blender-receiving.
Complete one finite receiving proof for C210's exact accepted after-source, GLB and semantic sidecar in installed Blender 4.3.2 (executable SHA-256 0dfe9af0f3e67643ecf15327fa5e14e7315f61d1a81afdcafe76a71b1918e2b4). Predeclare identity, units/frames, geometry, materials, baked animation, separate metadata mappings and information loss before any receiving execution.

Bounded files: new prototypes/semantic_receiving_c211/ and docs/engineering/semantic-receiving-c211/, new dedicated tests; current STATUS/navigation owned by root only after conditional integration lease. Existing compiler, Agent, GLB writer, frozen C199/C200/C201 files and historical evidence remain unchanged. C199/C200 schedules stay closed; C201 admission remains deferred.

Independent workers will implement adapter and review measurements in isolated branches from the observed base. Root owns serialized integration and the final verified saved C211 handoff. No second destination, general importer, live physics or authoring comparison in this scope.

## Initial evidence
C210 supplied recovery verified SHA-256 4757cfbd33fb97c919b58937cc8e2c85d6f3d1840887dca762b4dfc622aca558. Its full handoff has SHA-256 7066d33c8576b41e4dfa93da3383009e8b7e1fa1a28018de5d535e2342b61384 and is being independently verified/restored. No open PR; C210 issue #152 closed and integration lease released. New initial recovery checkpoint is confirmed saved. Broad historical regression failures remain failed; affected checks will report their own outcomes.

## Completion
Either an independently checked finite import and permitted integration, or a precisely documented capability/check blocker, followed by a verified restorable C211 ZIP with complete retained evidence and confirmed save.

## C211 closeout: blocked receiving gate; no active worker
Final documentation-only main is `12655f101f704050fb178ed1c7bb67e551f53eba`, tree `11ce678caab6761a6260997d6aad153c0b65651e`. The integration lease is released. Runtime/prototype/test bytes on main remain unchanged from C210; the receiver is held in draft PR #155 at `cdae8b582a37e37f76f142f07039ba74cedc08ad`.

One actual Blender 4.3.2 import recorded correct identities and metadata for 18 objects, positions and winding for 7,800 triangles, and 126 poses, but sphere split normals failed the frozen 2e-6 component limit (maximum 0.0001531541347503662). Rendering separately failed without OpenImageDenoise. No native save, reopen, reviewed image or second import occurred. The rendering correction is unexecuted and insufficient to resolve normal fidelity.

Source validation passed 302 affected methods and 54 fresh proof checks; exact accepted payloads reproduced, two Khronos validations and 252 Three.js pose comparisons passed. The broad mandatory attempt stopped at this concrete blocker: 1,476 observed passes and 3,205 methods without outcomes; no full regression pass. Original interrupted records and PID/group observation limits are retained.

**Next bounded action:** investigate and explicitly decide normal preservation/loss before another checkpointed receiving attempt. Preserve the original failed tolerance, reconcile this branch and ownership, and do not begin another destination or the comparison. C211 itself closes at its verified saved handoff. Final archive delivery and exact receipts are maintained in the [C211 recovery checkpoint](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-f548bef14e9481918d064fc82ae58224_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal).

title: C199: implement and qualify the finite static-tray mapping

Shared STATUS changes and main integration will occur only under a separately acquired verified bounded lease.

## Acceptance gate

A concrete failed preparation gate is retained with its exact repair action. Later tray admission and timed authors remain separate.

Preserve ordinary defaults, the C193 adapter, earlier runtime/tests/fixtures/contracts/evidence, and the inherited failed regression (4,239 passing methods; thirteen torque-read methods NOT RUN). No hosted job is requested.

The supplied C198 handoff has verified and restored offline; its inherited 911-file C196 recorded audit passed with no new native work. Current work will be published with actual evidence and a self-contained C199 handoff.

## C199 outcome and remaining qualification

PR #135 is merged at `83ff4a5533bbeea3c607a90734d3d8586671de6c` as an explicit incomplete experimental increment. The prototype is implemented, but the single approved native qualification stopped at N01 with pinned-exporter `KeyError: 'loglevel'` and a separately recorded action-filter callback error. One construction started; zero transactions were accepted, and no GLB was delivered. N02–N12 did not start. No retry or post-failure repair occurred.

The final preparation cohort passed 92 methods; reviewed L-R1 lifecycle preparation passed 8 cases / 131 checks; the native result review passed 38 checks. Actual-main verification passed 62 focused methods, the complete approved input closure, 29-source documentation preservation and 16 independent review checks. The inherited full regression remains failed.

C199 checkpoint work is closed with preserved failure evidence. Keep this issue open for the remaining qualification: C200 must review the logging and inactive action-filter compatibility repair and independently approve a new frozen bounded schedule. The C199 ledger must not be resumed or reset. Tray admission, timed authors and release remain separate gates. See `docs/engineering/static-tray-qualification-c199/NEXT-TASK.md`.
